entities.summary: Kalymnos is a Greek island and municipality in the southeastern Aegean Sea. It belongs to the Dodecanese island chain, between the islands of Kos and Leros, with the latter being linked to it through a series of islets. Kalymnos lies between two and five hours away by sea from the island of Rhodes.
